provenance: Original course diagrams derived from canonical Lecture 8; no external artwork.

figures.title: Moments choose an interval
figures.caption: Synthetic observations 1, 2, 3: the empirical variance uses denominator n. The fitted interval has the same mean and variance.

figures.title: A pair-count matrix
figures.caption: Illustrative counts, not corpus data or a covariance matrix. GloVe fits weighted log co-occurrence counts; these raw counts show the input structure.

figures.title: A shared hidden cause
figures.caption: Words are independent conditional on the topic. Without conditioning, the shared topic generally makes the words dependent.

figures.title: Weighted directions become orthonormal
figures.caption: Exact two-topic example: weights (0.25, 0.75), topics (0.8, 0.2) and (0.2, 0.8). Equal axis scales; the transformed weighted vectors have unit length and zero inner product.

figures.title: Separate density from communities
figures.caption: For balanced communities, the label vector is orthogonal to the constant vector. The population decomposition motivates a constrained spectral relaxation; it does not guarantee recovery from every observed graph.
